_about: Generated independently (Python hashlib SHA3-256 + hmac) from docs/KEY-SCHEDULE.md. Byte-pattern inputs are NOT valid keys, only hashed. Rust: tests/kdf_kat.rs.

rules.direction_key: k_dir = HMAC(session_key, D[gateway/vN/key/dir]), no further parts; N=3 for wire 3.2, N=2 for wire 2.1
rules.roles: the client seals with k_c2s and opens with k_s2c; the server seals with k_s2c and opens with k_c2s
rules.nonce: be32(0) || be64(counter), one counter per direction, each from 0
rules.receive: accept a frame only if its nonce is the next expected one, then advance
rules.sources: v3 session keys = handshake-v3.json session keys; v2 session key = handshake-v2.json session_key_pqc_only
